label: PF Backlog 638
title: design_critic / visual_qa integration (anti-patterns + catalog + aesthetics)
body:
## Problem / why
design_critic/visual_qa use shallow textual checks; the aesthetics skill is unused.

## Goal & value
QA validates against the chosen direction, non-negotiables and anti-patterns.

## In scope
- Edit core/design_critic.py (anti-patterns.md + non-negotiables + catalog conformance).
- Edit core/visual_qa.py to run visual-regression-aesthetics and compare vs direction + sample baselines.

## Out of scope
- Pixel-diff at scale in CI (baseline set grows later).

## Definition of Done
- Synthetic violations are caught in tests.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
